== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|High Consort Seredash is a leader within the Tanakite priesthood who rose to prominence by significantly increasing the influence of his clergy. He achieved this through a breakthrough in [[Pattern Construction]], which allowed him to access a realm he identifies as the world beyond all worlds and claim to have seen the deity Mul'Tanak. Driven by a desire for divine power, Seredash led a military campaign and utilized the [[blood]] of prisoners within the [[Tomb of Scrolls]] in an attempt to summon his goddess. His advanced abilities enabled him to manifest the limbs of mythical creatures through his constructed Patterns. During a [[ritual]] intended to facilitate this summoning, he confronted Mul'Tanak directly, only to be mortally wounded during the encounter.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Seredash is a tall man with a twisted physique. He wears red robes adorned with designs of spider legs and has painted symbols on his face to mimic the visage of a spider.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Driven by the desire for power promised by [[Mul’Tanak]], he led a campaign to achieve his goals. He is motivated by the belief that he possesses the capability to summon his goddess.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|He has the power to [[construct]] a [[Pattern]]. Through this [[technique]], he is able to manifest the limbs of impossible beasts.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A tall and twisted figure clad in red robes adorned with spider leg designs, High Consort Seredash bears painted symbols on his face to mimic a spider. Driven by the promise of power from the goddess [[Mul’Tanak]], he committed to a campaign and prostrated himself before her. Seredash believes in his ability to summon the deity and possesses the power to [[construct]] a [[Pattern]] that manifests the limbs of impossible beasts.}}
